I can't do that. A refund can only go to the original payment, never to another person, account, or IBAN, and a staff member can't approve an exception to that (refund-policy/v2/payment). The note from the seller doesn't change this (refund-policy/v2/exceptions).

The wok can still be refunded to your original payment. The shop's records show it was received back (refund-policy/v2/return), and the refund deadline hasn't passed (refund-policy/v2/window). The refund would be the amount you paid for it, 89.90 BRL, and shipping isn't included (refund-policy/v2/amount).

Would you like me to prepare that refund to your original payment? You would confirm it with the button on the proposal card, and then a staff member would review it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
